lyrics.ja: 生まれて初めて書いたのはなんて字だったかな
lyrics.romaji: Umarete Hajimete Kaita no ha Nante Ji Datta Kana
lyrics.en: What was the very first character I ever wrote?
lyrics.zh: 有生以來第一次寫下的，是什麼字呢

lyrics.ja: 初めて描いた似顔絵は誰の顔だっただろう
lyrics.romaji: Hajimete Kaita Nigaoe ha Dare no Kao Datta Darou
lyrics.en: Whose face was it in the first portrait I ever drew?
lyrics.zh: 第一次畫的肖像畫，又是誰的臉呢

lyrics.ja: 不思議だねもうずいぶん書き留めてきたけど
lyrics.romaji: Fushigi Da ne Mou Zuibun Kakitomete Kita kedo
lyrics.en: It's strange—I've written down so much already
lyrics.zh: 真不可思議，雖然已經記錄了好多好多

lyrics.ja: 最初の一筆は緊張しちゃうな
lyrics.romaji: Saisho no Ippitsu ha Kinchou Shichau na
lyrics.en: But that first stroke still makes me nervous
lyrics.zh: 最初的一筆，還是會緊張呢

lyrics.ja: 夢中になって歩いて まるまった芯の先
lyrics.romaji: Muchuu ni Natte Aruite Marumatta Shin no Saki
lyrics.en: Walking along, absorbed—the tip of a worn-down lead
lyrics.zh: 忘我地走著，變圓的筆芯尖端

lyrics.ja: 気づけばもう持てないくらい 短くなってたね
lyrics.romaji: Kizukeba Mou Motenai Kurai Mijikaku Natteta ne
lyrics.en: Before I knew it, it had gotten too short to hold, hadn't it?
lyrics.zh: 回過神來，已經短得握不住了

lyrics.ja: 知りたいこと やりたいこと 叶えたい夢さえ
lyrics.romaji: Shiritai Koto Yaritai Koto Kanaetai Yume Sae
lyrics.en: The things I want to know, the things I want to do, even the dreams I want to fulfill
lyrics.zh: 想知道的事、想做的事，甚至是渴望實現的夢想

lyrics.ja: いつだって一緒に形にしてきたんだ
lyrics.romaji: Itsu Datte Issho ni Katachi ni Shite Kita n Da
lyrics.en: I've always given them shape together with you
lyrics.zh: 一直以來都一起將它們化為形體

lyrics.ja: 裏表紙までいっぱいの思い出とたくさんの愛を
lyrics.romaji: Urabyoushi made Ippai no Omoide to Takusan no Ai wo
lyrics.en: Full of memories and so much love, all the way to the back cover
lyrics.zh: 直到封底，滿滿的回憶與許許多多的愛

lyrics.ja: 新たなページへと書き記していくよ
lyrics.romaji: Arata na Peeji e to Kakishirushite Iku yo
lyrics.en: I'll keep writing them onto new pages
lyrics.zh: 繼續書寫到嶄新的頁面上

lyrics.ja: はじまりは一直線に思いきり
lyrics.romaji: Hajimari ha Icchokusen ni Omoikiri
lyrics.en: The beginning—boldly, in one straight line
lyrics.zh: 開始時，就全力以赴地畫一條直線

lyrics.ja: 空まで伸ばしていこう
lyrics.romaji: Sora made Nobashite Ikou
lyrics.en: Let's stretch it all the way to the sky
lyrics.zh: 一直延伸到天空吧

lyrics.ja: はみ出しても 寄り道してもいい
lyrics.romaji: Hamidashite mo Yorimichi Shite mo Ii
lyrics.en: It's okay to go outside the lines or take detours
lyrics.zh: 就算超出框線，就算繞點遠路也沒關係

lyrics.ja: 風吹くままに
lyrics.romaji: Kaze Fuku Mama ni
lyrics.en: Just as the wind blows
lyrics.zh: 隨風而行

lyrics.ja: おわりまで一直線に描いたら
lyrics.romaji: Owari made Icchokusen ni Egaitara
lyrics.en: If I draw in one straight line all the way to the end
lyrics.zh: 若一路筆直畫到終點

lyrics.ja: きっと見えてくる
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Miete Kuru
lyrics.en: I'll surely come to see
lyrics.zh: 一定能看見

lyrics.ja: 新しい世界 私 その先まで
lyrics.romaji: Atarashii Sekai Watashi Sono Saki made
lyrics.en: A new world—me, all the way beyond
lyrics.zh: 嶄新的世界，我，直到更遠的彼方

lyrics.ja: 思い出したのは まだ右も左も真っ白なあの日
lyrics.romaji: Omoidashita no ha Mada Migi mo Hidari mo Masshiro na Ano Hi
lyrics.en: What I remembered was that day when left and right were still pure white
lyrics.zh: 想起的是，那時無論左右都還是一片空白的那一天

lyrics.ja: つたない持ち方だったけど 伝えたい言葉があふれて
lyrics.romaji: Tsutanai Mochikata Datta kedo Tsutaetai Kotoba ga Afurete
lyrics.en: I held it clumsily, but the words I wanted to say overflowed
lyrics.zh: 雖然握筆姿勢笨拙，想傳達的話語卻滿溢而出

lyrics.ja: 幸せの色も 涙落ちた跡も
lyrics.romaji: Shiawase no Iro mo Namida Ochita Ato mo
lyrics.en: The colors of happiness and the traces where tears fell
lyrics.zh: 幸福的顏色也好，眼淚滴落的痕跡也好

lyrics.ja: なんだって全部が宝物なの
lyrics.romaji: Nandatte Zenbu ga Takaramono na no
lyrics.en: Everything, no matter what, is a treasure
lyrics.zh: 無論什麼，全都是寶物

lyrics.ja: La, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la
lyrics.romaji: La, La, La, La, La, La, La, La, La, La, La, La, La
lyrics.en: La, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la
lyrics.zh: La, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la, la

lyrics.ja: あっという間に埋まっていった
lyrics.romaji: Atto Iu Ma ni Umatte Itta
lyrics.en: It filled up in the blink of an eye
lyrics.zh: 轉眼之間就被填滿了

lyrics.ja: 落書きだらけの日常は
lyrics.romaji: Rakugaki Darake no Nichijou ha
lyrics.en: These everyday days full of doodles
lyrics.zh: 滿是塗鴉的日常

lyrics.ja: 笑い合ってぶつかり合って重ねた
lyrics.romaji: Waraiatte Butsukariatte Kasaneta
lyrics.en: We laughed together, collided, and layered them
lyrics.zh: 一起歡笑、一起碰撞、彼此交疊

lyrics.ja: (物語はずっと続く)
lyrics.romaji: (Monogatari ha Zutto Tsuzuku)
lyrics.en: (The story goes on forever)
lyrics.zh: （故事將一直延續）

lyrics.ja: 消し跡だって愛しい軌跡
lyrics.romaji: Keshi Ato Datte Itoshii Kiseki
lyrics.en: Even eraser marks are precious traces
lyrics.zh: 連橡皮擦的痕跡都是可愛的軌跡

lyrics.ja: 大事に紡いだ証
lyrics.romaji: Daiji ni Tsumuida Akashi
lyrics.en: Proof carefully woven together
lyrics.zh: 用心編織的證明

lyrics.ja: 君となら大丈夫 叶えていけるから
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Nara Daijoubu Kanaete Ikeru kara
lyrics.en: With you, I'll be okay—we can make it come true
lyrics.zh: 只要和你一起就沒問題，一定能實現

lyrics.ja: 表紙を彩るのは思い出とたくさんの好きだ
lyrics.romaji: Hyoushi wo Irodoru no ha Omoide to Takusan no Suki Da
lyrics.en: What colors the cover are memories and so much love
lyrics.zh: 妝點封面的是回憶與滿滿的喜歡

lyrics.ja: どんなノートでも書き続けていくよ
lyrics.romaji: Donna Nooto demo Kakitsuzukete Iku yo
lyrics.en: I'll keep writing in any notebook
lyrics.zh: 無論是什麼樣的筆記本，都會繼續寫下去

lyrics.ja: 今もっともっと飛びだして!
lyrics.romaji: Ima Motto Motto Tobidashite!
lyrics.en: Now, leap out even more and more!
lyrics.zh: 現在，再更進一步飛奔出去！

lyrics.ja: 一直線に思いきり 空だって越えていこう
lyrics.romaji: Icchokusen ni Omoikiri Sora Datte Koete Ikou
lyrics.en: Boldly, in one straight line—let's even cross the sky
lyrics.zh: 全力以赴地畫一條直線，連天空也一同超越

lyrics.ja: はみ出しても 間違いなんてない
lyrics.romaji: Hamidashite mo Machigai Nante Nai
lyrics.en: Even if you go outside the lines, there are no mistakes
lyrics.zh: 即使超出框線，也不會有任何錯誤

lyrics.ja: 感じるままに
lyrics.romaji: Kanjiru Mama ni
lyrics.en: Just as you feel
lyrics.zh: 隨心所感

lyrics.ja: おわりまで一直線に描いたら
lyrics.romaji: Owari made Icchokusen ni Egaitara
lyrics.en: If I draw in one straight line all the way to the end
lyrics.zh: 若一路筆直畫到終點

lyrics.ja: きっとたどり着く
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Tadoritsuku
lyrics.en: I'll surely arrive
lyrics.zh: 一定能抵達

lyrics.ja: 新しい世界照らすその光へ
lyrics.romaji: Atarashii Sekai Terasu Sono Hikari e
lyrics.en: To that light illuminating a new world
lyrics.zh: 前往照亮嶄新世界的那道光
